statements.proposition: Microsoft documentation states desktop composition is always enabled since Windows 8.
statements.note: Statement about external documentation, not about an action in this change.
evidence: Item message: span cites learn.microsoft.com wm-dwmcompositionchanged page as background in '## Problem'

statements.proposition: This change adds a code comment referencing the Microsoft documentation (wm-dwmcompositionchanged).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: The bullet appears under both AxMsRdpClient09Host.xaml.cs and RDP.cs in the message; the comment was added in both (and in RdpConfig.cs), so either reading is true.
evidence: gh api repos/1Remote/1Remote/pulls/1011/files: AxMsRdpClient09Host.xaml.cs patch adds '// ref: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/dwm/wm-dwmcompositionchanged'
RDP.cs patch adds the same '// ref: ...wm-dwmcompositionchanged' comment above rdpConfig.AllowDesktopComposition = 1
RdpConfig.cs patch adds XML doc summary with the same ref URL

statements.proposition: After this change the application enables desktop composition in every display-performance mode and no longer disables it anywhere.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Labelled on the checkable code-level reading: composition flag 0x100 is now added unconditionally before the mode switch (so also Auto), AllowDesktopComposition is set to 1 before the switch and its default changed 0 -> 1, and no remaining code sets it to 0. Whether this actually prevents the reported HRESULT error (stack trace is in local WPF WindowChrome) is not claimed by this span and was not checked; nothing was built or run (Windows/.NET app).
evidence: AxMsRdpClient09Host.xaml.cs at head e265bfe lines 598-602: nDisplayPerformanceFlag += 0x00000100 outside the 'if (DisplayPerformance != Auto)' block; PerformanceFlags = nDisplayPerformanceFlag after it
RDP.cs patch: AllowDesktopComposition = 1 set before switch; '= 0' removed from Low case
git grep -n -i 'DesktopComposition\|0x00000100' -- '*.cs' at head: only RDP.cs:778 (=1), RdpConfig.cs:141 (=1), host :602 (+0x100), plus unrelated importer/WinAPI constants; no assignment to 0
